Title: Servius Marius Pustula + Illusions of the Kindred

Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
===
Servius Marius Pustula [Third:V]
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Nosferatu antitribu
Group: 4
Capacity: 10
Discipline: obf ANI CHI DOM OBT POT
Sabbat:
Each Methuselah gets +X hand size, where X is the number of ready vampires
with capacity above 7 he or she controls.
===

If Servius plays Illusions of the Kindred, and reveals a vampire with capacity
above 7, does your hand size go up by 1 during that combat?
Card text implies "Yes".

If Servius plays Illusions of the Kindred and reveals another copy of Servius,
does the ability "double"?
i.e. if I control Servius and Ysador, with a current handsize of 9, and Servius
plays Illusions and reveals another copy of Servius, is my hand size now 13
during that combat (7+3+3) ?
Card text also implies "Yes" for this.

Just making sure...
